title: grindelia tricuspis
intro: Grindelia tricuspis, commonly known as gumweed or sticky gumweed, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory issues and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include expectorant and emollient properties, making it useful for soothing coughs and calming irritated skin. Grindelia tricuspis contains bioactive constituents like sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
